limitations: All results are feasibility observations over six completed selected-block frames.
The two failed exact-layout references are counted separately and are not executions.
No transaction is reclassified as economically exact; no native amount, wallet-net price, fee, or rent reserve is derived.
Target/account-reference paths prove observation, not an account write.
The captured provider trace and transaction-boundary balances do not prove global completeness or historical account state.

rent_semantics.policy: No rent-exempt reserve is inferred from SyncNative residuals or present-day rent configuration. Each account reports whether its transaction capture exposes the rent sysvar and create-account funding.
